description: Preview the Synmerco fee for an amount, computed by the server (GET /v1/calculate-fee) with the live tier table: Standard 3.25% below $100K (includes the 0.25% Shield and 0.25% referral shares), High-Value 2% from $100K, Institutional 1% from $1M, bespoke from $5M. The fee comes out of the seller payout. One escrow holds $5 to $100,000; larger deals run as escrow groups priced by the group total. Returns feeCents, feeBps, tierName, shieldBps, referrerEligibleBps and netToSellerCents. Free, no auth required.

amountCents.description: Amount in cents (500 = $5; escrows start at 500)

name: estimate_fees
